kind: Real CLI content checks through a native OpenAI client
method: The native shell ran the installed CLI against separate synthetic records in an evaluator-owned sandbox fork. A launcher injected the token only into CLI subprocesses and redacted output. Skills were copied into scratch workspaces and explicitly catalogued. Independent saved-record reads and opaque version-ID listings checked results. Each operation ran on a fresh record; recovered command, validation, or verification errors remain failures.
limitations: This is real CLI execution, not hosted MCP/OAuth, native plugin installation, automatic invocation, or Claude Desktop verification.
Source refinements and all diagnostic failures are retained by snapshot and run. A passing cohort does not establish universal reliability.
Provider counters are recorded as returned, including cache usage; unique context size, monetary billing, and isolated account-limit consumption are unavailable.
Structured-2 contains a later manual, read-only typing probe in its local CLI log. Agent metrics use its previously frozen result; the probe is excluded.
Structured-11 was paused to keep the shared managed CLI workspace sequential; its elapsed time includes the pause. It is diagnostic only.

cleanup.scope: Only the uniquely named sandbox created by this evaluation; concurrent project tests are permitted
cleanup.globalModelCountGate: Not used: the project owner confirmed concurrent tests. No global model or environment counts were restored or asserted constant.
